reviews.title: Bad…
reviews.text: Very low quality app in my opinion, there’s very little content and just not worth your time. Download another app if you want to get anywhere

reviews.title: Ad free mode
reviews.text:
I paid for the ad free version but the very annoying Remove Ads sign will not disappear from the screen. It takes up 75% of the screen so I can’t enlarge the videos. 
Especially under the Finger Spelling section. 
I have tried to close the app and restart a couple of times to no avail.
